summary_bullets: Ensure sparse allowlist additions reconcile on already-latest installs instead of being skipped by idempotency
Make release apply working-tree sparse allowlist changes against the active install root and require restart after cone repair
Warn operators at SessionStart when the local marketplace sparse cone drifts from the shipped allowlist
Cover sparse-cone reconciliation, release root resolution, and hook fail-open behavior with hermetic harnesses
commit_message:
Reconcile sparse allowlist drift during upgrade

Move the install sparse allowlist into a sourced-only library, make /upgrade-larch gate its already-latest early exit on a matching sparse cone, and emit a machine-readable reconcile signal after same-version cone repairs.

Teach /release to run the working-tree upgrade script against the active cache root and persist cone-reconcile state for restart guidance. Add a SessionStart warn-only sparse-cone drift probe and update operator/security docs.

Extend the upgrade and SessionStart harnesses for sparse-cone drift, release root resolution, captured reconcile detection, and fail-open hook behavior.
